system.description:
Range: 30 spaces

You tap into the stream of time to uncover hidden things. Through a brief series of bizarre hallucinatory visions, you learn one of the following secrets:

  • Weakness

    • Choose a creature within 30 spaces. The Difficulty of the next attack check you make against that creature is 2.

    • Alternatively, the next time you target the creature with a spell or Path ability that requires a check to resist, the Difficulty of the Resistance check is 6.

    • Additionally, you learn of any special vulnerabilities the creature might have, such as only being able to be killed by fire.

  • Treasure

    • You learn the exact location of what you would consider to be the most valuable resource or item within 30 spaces. The specifics of this object are left up to the GM, but could for example be used to locate the item with the highest monetary value, determine which piece of food has the best taste, or uncover an object that is immediately helpful to your survival.

    • Alternatively, you learn the location of the object you want the most if it is within 30 spaces, or its direction if it lies beyond that range. This must be a specific object that you believe exists and deeply yearn for, and can include living creatures.

  • Secret Hiding Place

    • You learn of a secret hiding place within 30 spaces, provided that one exists.

    • This could be a place someone could hide an item of value, or somewhere you could use to hide.

    • If the hiding place is big enough for you to fit, you have Greater Advantage on Stealth checks to hide while you are within the hiding space. This does not include moving to the hiding space.
